response.overview: Take a live tour of the current Wisconsin night sky in this 22-minute guided Planetarium program. A lively astronomy educator will show you all of the current sights on a clear Dome Theater “sky,” such as planets, constellations, meteors, and other fun celestial phenomena.
response.tagline: Take a live tour of the current Wisconsin night sky in this 22-minute guided Planetarium program.
response.title: Wisconsin Stargazing
